name: shell
description: 执行 shell 命令并返回 stdout、stderr 和退出码。默认超时 30 秒。使用 cwd 设置工作目录；shell 指定 shell 类型（cmd/powershell/bash），实际可用性以系统提示「Shell 环境（启动时实测）」段为准——请求的 shell 不存在时自动回退默认 shell 并在结果尾部回告，后续命令应改按实际 shell 语法编写。命令语法必须匹配所用 shell（PowerShell、CMD、bash 互不兼容）。警告：此工具以用户权限执行任意命令。
description_en: Execute a shell command and return stdout, stderr and exit code. Default timeout is 30 seconds. Use cwd to set the working directory; shell picks the shell type (cmd/powershell/bash) — actual availability is listed in the system prompt's Shell environment section (probed at startup). If the requested shell is unavailable, the default shell is used and noted in the result; write subsequent commands for the actual shell. Command syntax must match the shell in use (PowerShell, CMD and bash are mutually incompatible). Warning: this tool executes arbitrary commands with user privileges.

command.description: 要执行的 shell 命令

cwd.description: 命令的工作目录（默认：agent 工作目录）
cwd.description_en: Working directory for the command (default: agent working directory)

env.description: 额外的环境变量（与 process.env 合并）。

shell.description: 指定使用的 shell。不指定时用系统信息中声明的默认 shell（实测探测）；请求不可用时自动回退并回告。
shell.description_en: Which shell to use. Defaults to the probed default shell declared in system info; unavailable requests fall back with a note in the result.
